workload: Interleave the next archived threshold from each context in round-robin order. Keep parity and Delft as separate immutable traces. Each Delft round visits full-trace contexts and then first-eighth contexts.
cache: Share one least-recently-used cache of verified source chunks, directory pages, and change blocks. Weight each by its encoded payload length with a minimum of one byte. Keep the admitted root and common manifest outside this cache and charge any initial root read.

policies.packed: Use packed source for every question.
policies.partition: Use the verified partition for every question.
policies.alternating: Alternate packed source and partition to expose interference in the shared cache.
policies.bounded: Reevaluate the strict-improvement check against the unpaid root and a conservative packed upper bound. Route to packed if pruning succeeds; otherwise prefer the partition.

upperBound: If all relevant packed chunks are already verified and resident, the packed query needs zero new reads. Otherwise charge one read of each possible chunk per window and scan phase, counting a chunk again whenever another window or phase may reload it.
criterion: Match archived answers and preserve capacity. Measure first reads, verified rereads after eviction, and which representation evicts which cache entries. Charge encoded reads; do not interpret cache weight as process memory or measure wall time.
